target.statement: SONO score of nominal outlyingness for outliers on the Solar Flare dataset (or comparable UCI dataset), as reported in the paper's application section.

compute.basis: The method is a combinatorial itemset search on small UCI datasets (hundreds of rows, <20 nominal variables); the R package SONO implements the algorithm, so a clean re-run on Solar Flare should take minutes on a laptop.

blockers: The linked GitHub repository only contains simulation code, not the UCI application scripts; the R package SONO (CRAN) may need to be used instead.
Exact reproduction of the reported scores may require matching hyperparameter choices (alpha, r) not fully specified in the paper.
title: A novel framework for quantifying nominal outlyingness
